text:
Kansas City dị n'akụkụ steeti Missouri–Kansas, na nkwụsị nke osimiri Missouri na Kansas, na metro na-agafe steeti abụọ ahụ. E tinyere ya dị ka Town of Kansas na 1850, tinyeghachi ya dị ka City of Kansas na 1853, ma kpọgharịa ya Kansas City na 1889.

Dị ka obodo kachasị ibu na Missouri, ọ toro ghọọ ebe ụgbọ okporo ígwè, ebe anụ na ebe azụmahịa nke American Midwest. A maara ya n'ụwa niile maka ihe nketa jazz ya, nke dị na mpaghara 18th & Vine, maka Kansas City-style barbecue, na maka isi mmiri ya.

Maka ọnụọgụ ya, Kansas City bụ obodo bọọlụ miri emi. Ọ bụ ebe obibi Sporting Kansas City, otu bọọlụ charter tọrọ ntọala na 1996 dị ka Kansas City Wiz, mgbe e mesịrị Wizards. Klọb ahụ na-egwuri egwu na Arrowhead ruo 2007 tupu ọ kwaga n'ụlọ egwuregwu nke ya. Obodo ahụ bụkwa ebe obibi Kansas City Current nke NWSL, ndị wuru ụlọ egwuregwu mbụ e mere maka otu ụmụ nwanyị ọkachamara. Kansas City nabatara 2024 Copa América tinyere ọtụtụ egwuregwu USMNT na Gold Cup. N'aka nke ọzọ, na gridiron, ndị NFL Chiefs na-eme Arrowhead otu n'ime ebe kacha mkpọtụ na egwuregwu.
